strategy.offer: Managed cloud communication services for secure business messaging, integration, security, archiving, file exchange, and electronic document workflows across multiple channels.
strategy.customers: Businesses, public institutions, and channel partners needing reliable, compliant, high-volume communications in critical or regulated processes across industries.
strategy.why_we_win: The firm argues it wins through reliable, secure, globally available services, easy integration, flexible service levels, transparent usage-based pricing, and continuous innovation.
strategy.resources: Its basis is messaging expertise, proprietary data centers, developed interfaces, technical and support teams, partner enablement, and sustained research and development investment.
strategy.direction: It is heading toward more innovative enterprise messaging that supports digital business processes, better customer experience, and broader global, multichannel cloud adoption.

strategy.offer: Cloud platforms and managed services for secure business communication, including email security, fax, messaging, EDI, document capture, process automation, archiving, and integration.
strategy.customers: Mid-sized and large enterprises, global corporations, and technology service providers that need secure, integrated communication and information exchange in critical workflows.
strategy.why_we_win: By offering one highly available, compliant cloud environment that secures and automates multiple communication channels, integrates easily with existing systems, and reduces manual effort.
strategy.resources: Self-developed cloud technology, proprietary data centers, standard interfaces and APIs, global operational footprint, multilingual technical support, and expertise in hosted communication services.
strategy.direction: Toward broader enterprise cloud communications that make business processes more reliable, efficient, flexible, automated, transparent, and compliant worldwide.
